sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "yes" on one switch "no" on the other

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Ask the switch user to think of a person, place, or thing.
2. Take turns asking questions to work out what they are thinking of.
3. The switch user uses their switch to answer yes or no.
4. Award a point for each question answered before the correct answer is guessed.
5. For a competitive version, play in two teams and see which team scores the most points.
